{"CommandLine":"python -c "
import requests, json
session = requests.Session()
BASE_URL = 'http://localhost:5000/api'

# Login
session.post(f'{BASE_URL}/auth/login', json={'email': 'a', 'password': 'a'})

# Try to get CSRF - check various endpoints
for ep in ['/auth/csrf', '/csrf', '/auth/token', '/csrf-token']:
    try:
        r = session.get(f'{BASE_URL}{ep}')
        print(f'{ep}: {r.status_code} {r.text[:100]}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{ep}: ERROR {e}')

# Try POST to emissions directly (session cookie based)
print('--- Testing POST without CSRF ---')
r = session.post(f'{BASE_URL}/emissions', json={
    'source_type': 'Combustion', 'sub_type': 'Stationary', 'fuel_type': 'Natural Gas',
    'quantity': 9999.0, 'unit': 'MMBtu', 'facility_id': 1, 'year': 2024, 'month': 12, 'notes': 'Test'
})
print(f'POST emissions (no CSRF): {r.status_code} {r.text[:200]}')

# Check if there's a CSRF token in cookies after login
print('Cookies:', dict(session.cookies))
" 2>&1
